head: Delta emulator on iPhone Duo: bigger DS screen in update 2.0.2b
dek: Delta's 2.0.2b update adds a DS skin with a larger top screen that fills more of the iPhone Duo's inner display, a six-button Genesis skin and a speed limit for fast-forward up to 8x. Patrons get it first; the free app gets it later.
details: The update also lets you hide Favorites and Recently Played in the game library and turns off RetroAchievements Hardcore mode for games that don't support it. Fixes include full-screen play over AirPlay and external displays on iOS 27, working Genesis Game Genie and Action Replay codes, and the DS CheatBase. The Delta team says it has started on a larger 2.1 update. No date was given for the free version.
where: Delta on iPhone, for Patrons now; the free app later
means: If you play DS games in Delta on an iPhone Duo, the top screen no longer has to stay small on the big inner display.
todo: Patrons can update now. Everyone else: keep Delta updated and look for 2.0.2b in the free app; the speed limit sits in Advanced Settings.
thumb_words: DELTA: BIGGER DS SCREEN ON DUO
